41,959 instrument-sessions, 34 instruments, London sessions 2018-04 to 2022-12 (fields need a year of M1 history first; M1 starts 2016-10). 2023 onward is not looked at. Every field uses only data from before the session; models are refitted each quarter on earlier sessions.

The five fields are about two and a half, not five. The first principal component holds 61% of their variance and the second 22% (independent fields would be 20% each). σ now and σ vs long-run correlate 0.90; P(high regime) correlates 0.69 with σ now.

σ alone is not flat across its own deciles: on the lowest-σ decile the session range is 1.86σ, on the highest 1.41σ (all-session mean 1.60σ). The live σ over-reacts: it is too high after loud spells and too low after quiet ones.

Forecast error is the field that adds most beyond σ: top-decile minus bottom-decile range is +0.39σ [+0.29, +0.48] (shuffled field −0.03σ). Positive in all 5 years (+0.23 to +0.39 by fifths) and all 4 classes. P(high regime) adds nothing beyond σ (+0.02σ [−0.09, +0.15]); expected change adds little (+0.07σ, interval crosses 0).

As a forecast of the session's 5-min realised variance, log-HAR on M1 beats the live σ: QLIKE 0.77 [0.73, 0.81] of the live σ's loss, below 1 in every year and every instrument, but only 0.96-0.97 on EURUSD, NZDUSD and USDCAD. On the squared-range yardstick (no home advantage) HAR is 0.89. σ × the error feedback is 0.92 [0.87, 0.96]. Fitted daily GARCH(1,1) is worse than the live σ (1.17).
Expected change does point the right way: correlation 0.38 with next week's change in vol, against 0.21 for plain mean reversion (−σ vs long-run).

For stops: a 1σ stop from the open is reached on 29.6% of sessions. When recent sessions ran hotter than σ (top two fifths of the error) it is 32-33%; when they ran cooler, 25-28%. The width hit on 20% of days goes from 1.13σ to 1.43σ across error deciles, against one width of 1.26σ for all days. The regime probability barely moves either.
Descriptive only: deciles are over the whole window, nothing is scored as a trade, and costs are not in. The state's job here looks like resizing σ (error and level), not naming a regime.
